name: longterm
description: Claude keeps a plan, a list of next steps or any snippet you will come back to in your Longterm pane, for the session. Earlier sessions' snippets wait a few days, for you or Claude to bring back.

keepDays.title: Keep earlier snippets (days)
keepDays.description: An earlier session's snippet waits this long after its last change, for you or Claude to bring it into a new session. Then it is gone.
